label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Hey Hollins Family Ties ❤️ Mom keeps getting asked if I’m coming to Thanksgiving, so let me answer for myself: yes, I’m coming! Thursday, Nov. 26 at Aunt Denise’s in Macon, eating around 3. I’m bringing mac and cheese and two sweet potato pies, so save me some oven space.

I also want to say something before we’re all sitting around the table. Last Thanksgiving, a conversation about my job turned into an argument, and I helped make it ugly. I got personal and took a cheap shot instead of letting it go. I’m sorry for how I talked at Grandma’s holiday, and especially that she ended up out on the porch instead of enjoying the day with everybody. That part has stayed with me.

I’m not sorry for the work I do, but I can stand by it without talking to family that way. For the cousins who weren’t there, you don’t need a recap, and I’m not trying to start round two in the comments.

What I am asking for is a one-day truce on work and politics. Also, questions about “the lawsuit” won’t get very far: I can’t discuss open cases because of confidentiality. That’s true at Thanksgiving or any other day, even with family.

I know we like to poke at each other. I also know we care about each other, even when a birthday thumbs-up is the closest we get to a big emotional speech. I’d like us to have a good day together this year, and I’ll do my part.

Can we keep the table talk to food, football, babies, and Tasha’s new boyfriend? Tasha, I’m sorry to put your business on the agenda, but we need something.

Love y’all. I’m coming, I’m bringing food, and I’m looking forward to seeing everybody.
